name: Space Romance 🌌
source: Young cadet Aiya has scored the position of her dreams! Her beloved captain is her academy crush, and now they’re going to spend a whole year together in space! Alone on his research vessel! What she doesn’t know is that he too has been waiting for this very moment!
translation: Young cadet Aiya has scored the position of her dreams! Her beloved captain is her academy crush, and now they’re going to spend a whole year together in space! Alone on his research vessel! What she doesn’t know is that he too has been waiting for this very moment!
